description: This file defines the configuration interface for the Cuttlefish Android emulator, including enums, classes, and methods for managing emulator instances, their properties, and related configurations.

classes.name: CuttlefishConfig
classes.description: Main class managing the configuration of Cuttlefish emulator instances, including methods for loading, saving, and accessing configuration parameters.

classes.name: CuttlefishConfig::InstanceSpecific
classes.description: Represents a specific emulator instance's configuration view.

classes.name: CuttlefishConfig::MutableInstanceSpecific
classes.description: Mutable version of InstanceSpecific for modifying instance configurations.

classes.name: CuttlefishConfig::MutableEnvironmentSpecific
classes.description: Mutable version of EnvironmentSpecific for modifying environment configurations.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns a singleton pointer to the global CuttlefishConfig instance.

methods.name: GetFromFile
methods.description: Loads configuration from a specified file path.

methods.name: ConfigExists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration file exists.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Saves the current configuration to a file.

methods.name: LoadFromFile
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a file.

methods.name: Instances
methods.description: Returns a list of all configured emulator instances.

methods.name: ForInstance
methods.description: Returns a specific instance configuration view by index.

methods.name: ForInstanceName
methods.description: Returns a specific instance configuration view by name.

methods.name: InstanceDirectories
methods.description: Returns the list of directories for all instances.

methods.name: InstanceSpecific::PerInstancePath
methods.description: Returns the path to a file within the instance directory.

methods.name: InstanceSpecific::PerInstanceUdsPath
methods.description: Returns the Unix domain socket path for the instance.

methods.name: IsRestoring
methods.description: Checks if the emulator is restoring from a snapshot.
